svg.title: Prevent Forest Fires — British Columbia Forest Service
svg.desc: A constructed vector reconstruction from a supplied photograph: yellow sky, dark conifers, orange flames, custom ivory script and dark italic lettering, a burnt woodland foreground, and the slogan Fire destroys timber and payrolls. All artwork and lettering are editable vector paths. No source image, autotracing, or external typeface is used. Illustration details and colours are interpretive, not a verified archival facsimile.

g.aria-label: Fire destroys timber and payrolls! British Columbia Forest Service
